ops.text: drive on a Sprite lane (~/.local/bin/drive) blocks on one Orca question per verb, and the coordinator took over 2h to answer drive pr add and drive job set --repro, past Claude Code's longest background timeout (7,200,000 ms). The local process was killed, the answer arrived later only as an orca orchestration check message ('drive exited 0' plus its output), and the script never prints the question's messageId, so the lane cannot --resume the pending question and asks again, which registered PR yasyf/cc-skills#5408 twice. Fix: print the messageId before waiting, so a killed wait resumes the same question instead of asking twice.
